description:
Call ONLY after the file(s) returned by onboard_data_source have actually been uploaded (each PUT returned HTTP 200) — kicks off AI analysis and waits until the spec reaches "ready" or "failed".

This tool verifies the upload against storage before starting anything. If a file is not there it refuses, spends no credits, and returns a fresh upload URL plus the exact curl command — complete the upload and call this again. Calling it in the hope that analysis will work without the upload cannot succeed; if you have no filesystem access, ask the user to attach the file and upload it first.

If it returns before the spec settles (timedOut: true), do NOT call this tool again just to keep checking — that re-attempts starting analysis. Poll with get_status (specId) instead until it reaches a terminal status.

loadSampleData.description: Whether to load the sample file and trigger the data-load job once analysis finishes (default true).

specName.description: Name of the data spec being onboarded.

workspaceId.description: Workspace to act on. Defaults to your only workspace if you have exactly one.
